cards.front: Recall a key point about Choreographic Intention & Communication
cards.back: Choreographic intention is the purpose or message behind a dance — what the choreographer wants to communicate

cards.front: Recall a key point about Choreographic Intention & Communication
cards.back: Every choreographic decision should serve the intention, from movement choices to structure and staging

cards.front: Recall a key point about Choreographic Intention & Communication
cards.back: Mood is the atmosphere or feeling a dance creates — for example, tense, joyful, melancholic

cards.front: Recall a key point about Choreographic Intention & Communication
cards.back: Meaning is the deeper message or idea the dance conveys to the audience

cards.front: Recall a key point about Choreographic Intention & Communication
cards.back: Motifs are key movement phrases that represent the core idea of the dance

cards.front: Recall a key point about Choreographic Intention & Communication
cards.back: Developing and varying motifs throughout a dance reinforces the intention

cards.front: Recall a key point about Choreographic Intention & Communication
cards.back: Dynamics, space and relationships all contribute to communicating intention

cards.front: Recall a key point about Choreographic Intention & Communication
cards.back: The audience's interpretation may differ from the choreographer's intention — this is valid

cards.front: Recall a key point about Choreographic Intention & Communication
cards.back: In AQA 8236, you must state and explain your choreographic intention clearly

cards.front: Recall a key point about Choreographic Intention & Communication
cards.back: Professional choreographers often explain their intention in programme notes or interviews

cards.front: Recall a key point about Choreographic Intention & Communication
cards.back: Choreographic intention should be identifiable from the movement itself, not just the title

cards.front: Recall a key point about Choreographic Intention & Communication
cards.back: Evaluating how effectively a dance communicates its intention is a key exam skill

cards.front: What should you know about gcse dance exam tips — choreographic intention & communication?
cards.back: 1. For Choreographic Intention & Communication questions, identify the relevant area of law and state the legal principles clearly 2. Apply legal rules to the facts of the scenario — don't just state the law 3. When evaluating, consider both the effectiveness and fairness of legal rules 4. Reference relevant cases and statutes when discussing Choreographic Intention & Communication 5. Consider reform proposals and alternative approaches where relevant
